```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
final <- read.csv("nhl_2025_26_player_shift_data.csv")
setorder(shift_ivl, shift_id, interval_start)
shift_strength <- shift_ivl[, .(strength = first(strength)), by = shift_id]
```

 1. For each icing-flagged shift, get how long the player had
    already been on the ice at the moment of the icing

```{r}
icing_moment_strength <- shift_ivl[
  is_icing_moment == TRUE,
  .(shift_id, strength_at_icing = strength)
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build per-shift icing info: who, when in the shift it
#    happened, and what strength state it was at that moment
# ------------------------------------------------------------
icing_shifts_info <- shifts[
  has_icing == TRUE,
  .(shift_id, player_id, team, shift_start, shift_end)
]
icing_shifts_info <- merge(icing_shifts_info, icing_interval_lookup, by = "shift_id")
icing_shifts_info <- merge(icing_shifts_info, icing_moment_strength, by = "shift_id")
icing_shifts_info[, time_in_shift_at_icing := icing_interval_start - shift_start]

# filter to EV-only icings
icing_shifts_info <- icing_shifts_info[strength_at_icing == "EV"]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Sum xGA/xGF for the portion of each shift AFTER the icing
#    (strictly after -- the interval containing the icing itself
#    is excluded since the whistle could occur anywhere within it)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
post_icing_xg <- shift_ivl[
  shift_id %in% icing_shifts_info$shift_id,
  .(interval_start, xGA, xGF, icing_interval_start)
][
  interval_start > icing_interval_start,
  .(
    post_icing_xGA = sum(xGA),
    post_icing_xGF = sum(xGF),
    post_icing_seconds = .N * 5L
  ),
  by = shift_id
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Combine and normalize xGA/xGF by actual post-icing exposure
#    time, so buckets with less remaining shift time aren't
#    penalized just for having less time to accumulate xG
# ------------------------------------------------------------
icing_analysis <- merge(
  icing_shifts_info[, .(shift_id, player_id, team, time_in_shift_at_icing)],
  post_icing_xg,
  by = "shift_id"
)

icing_analysis[, xGA_per_60 := post_icing_xGA / post_icing_seconds * 60]
icing_analysis[, xGF_per_60 := post_icing_xGF / post_icing_seconds * 60]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Bucket by how long they'd already been on the ice when
#    they iced the puck
# ------------------------------------------------------------
icing_analysis[, time_bucket := cut(
  time_in_shift_at_icing,
  breaks = c(-1, 15, 30, 45, 60, Inf),
  labels = c("0-15s", "15-30s", "30-45s", "45-60s", "60s+")
)]

icing_summary_ev <- icing_analysis[, .(
  n_player_shifts = .N,
  avg_post_icing_seconds = round(mean(post_icing_seconds), 1),
  mean_xGA_per_60 = round(mean(xGA_per_60), 3),
  mean_xGF_per_60 = round(mean(xGF_per_60), 3)
), by = time_bucket]

setorder(icing_summary_ev, time_bucket)
print(icing_summary_ev)
```
